title: A sheaf of modules on a basis extends uniquely to a sheaf of modules
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a set of open subsets of $X$ which is a basis of the topology, such that $U\cap V\in\mathcal B$ for $U,V\in\mathcal B$, and such that for every $U\in\mathcal B$ every covering of $U$ by members of $\mathcal B$ can be refined to a finite covering of $U$ by members of $\mathcal B$. Let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of rings on $X$. Suppose given, for every $U\in\mathcal B$, an $\mathcal O(U)$-module $F(U)$, and for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ an additive map $r_{U,V}:F(U)\to F(V)$ with $r_{U,U}=\mathrm{id}$, $r_{V,W}r_{U,V}=r_{U,W}$ and $r_{U,V}(as)=a|_V\,r_{U,V}(s)$ for $a\in\mathcal O(U)$, such that for every $U\in\mathcal B$ and every finite covering $U=U_1\cup\dots\cup U_n$ with $U_i\in\mathcal B$ the sequence $0\to F(U)\to\prod_iF(U_i)\rightrightarrows\prod_{i,j}F(U_i\cap U_j)$ is exact (an element is determined by its restrictions, and a family agreeing on the $U_i\cap U_j$ comes from an element). Then: (a) there is a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $F^{ext}$ on $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] together with $\mathcal O(U)$-linear isomorphisms $\iota_U:F^{ext}(U)\to F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ with $\iota_V(t|_V)=r_{U,V}(\iota_U(t))$; (b) for every sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal G$ on $X$ and every family of $\mathcal O(U)$-linear maps $\psi_U:F(U)\to\mathcal G(U)$, $U\in\mathcal B$, compatible with the restrictions, there is a unique morphism of $\mathcal O$-modules $\Psi:F^{ext}\to\mathcal G$ with $\Psi_U=\psi_U\circ\iota_U$ for all $U\in\mathcal B$, and $\Psi$ is an isomorphism if all $\psi_U$ are bijective; in particular $(F^{ext},\iota)$ is unique up to unique isomorphism; (c) for $x\in X$ the stalk $F^{ext}_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is the colimit of the $F(U)$ over the members $U\in\mathcal B$ containing $x$ (directed by reverse inclusion), via the maps $F(U)\xrightarrow{\iota_U^{-1}}F^{ext}(U)\to F^{ext}_x$.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Section 009H (label section-bases): Definition 009J (sheaf on a basis), Lemma 009L (label lemma-cofinal-systems-coverings-standard-case: the sheaf condition on a cofinal system of coverings, here the finite ones), Lemma 009M (label lemma-condition-star-sections) and Lemma 009N (label lemma-extend-off-basis) with its proof (sections of the extension are compatible families of germs in the colimit stalks), Definition 009S, Lemma 009T (label lemma-extend-off-basis-module), Lemma 009U (label lemma-restrict-basis-equivalence-modules)
